metadata.question: Does vegetation greenness (NDVI) in Toliara, Madagascar on average decrease during September 2021-2022 compared to the 2000-2015 average for the same period?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: MODIS NDVI 16-day composite (MOD13Q1) provides 250 m NDVI back to 2000 and up to 2023 with ready-made NDVI band, avoiding cloud-mask issues. – ROI: Toliara (Pt: 43.68°E, 23.35°S) → small 5-km buffer. – Compare Sept-2021–Sept-2022 mean NDVI vs. 2000-2015 Sept mean NDVI. 2. Masking: MOD13Q1 NDVI already QA-filtered; only mask out fill (-3000) and keep valid range (-2000–10 000) using the supplied scale factor 0.0001. 3. Null / Valid-zero check: – After masking, count valid pixels; print size/count. – If any collection size is 0 → C1. – If valid-pixel count = 0 → C2. – If computed mean NDVI is None/NaN or outside [-1,1] after scaling → C3. – Else decide: if 2021-2022 mean < 2000-2015 mean → A (Yes), else B (No). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') pt = ee.Geometry.Point([43.68, -23.35]) # Toliara roi = pt.buffer(5000) # 5 km radius sep = ee.Filter.calendarRange(9, 9, 'month') base = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1') .filterDate('2000-01-01', '2016-01-01').filter(sep) .select('NDVI')) base_n = base.size().getInfo() if base_n == 0: print("No baseline MOD13Q1 images."); print("C1") exit() test = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1') .filterDate('2021-09-01', '2022-10-01').filter(sep) .select('NDVI')) test_n = test.size().getInfo() if test_n == 0: print("No 2021-2022 MOD13Q1 images."); print("C1") exit() def mod_nd(img): # valid NDVI scale 0.0001, mask fill return img.updateMask(img.neq(-3000)).multiply(0.0001) def mean_nd(col, name): img = (col.map(mod_nd).mean() .multiply(10000).round().multiply(0.0001)) # round to .0001 cnt = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()['NDVI'] val = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=roi, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()['NDVI'] if cnt is None or cnt == 0: print(f"{name} valid pixels: {int(cnt) if cnt else 0}") print("C2") exit() if val is None or not -1 <= val <= 1: print("C3") exit() print(f"{name} Images: {col.size().getInfo()}, NDVI mean: {val:.4f}, Pixels: {int(cnt)}") return val base_v = mean_nd(base, "2000-2015") test_v = mean_nd(test, "2021-2022") if test_v < base_v: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

pt = ee.Geometry.Point([43.68, -23.35])  # Toliara
roi = pt.buffer(5000)  # 5 km radius
sep = ee.Filter.calendarRange(9, 9, 'month')

base = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1')
          .filterDate('2000-01-01', '2016-01-01').filter(sep)
          .select('NDVI'))
base_n = base.size().getInfo()
if base_n == 0:
    print("No baseline MOD13Q1 images."); print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

test = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1')
          .filterDate('2021-09-01', '2022-10-01').filter(sep)
          .select('NDVI'))
test_n = test.size().getInfo()
if test_n == 0:
    print("No 2021-2022 MOD13Q1 images."); print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

def mod_nd(img):  # valid NDVI scale 0.0001, mask fill
    return img.updateMask(img.neq(-3000)).multiply(0.0001)

def mean_nd(col, name):
    img = (col.map(mod_nd).mean()
            .multiply(10000).round().multiply(0.0001))  # round to .0001
    cnt = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                          geometry=roi, scale=250,
                          maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()['NDVI']
    val = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                          geometry=roi, scale=250,
                          maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()['NDVI']
    if cnt is None or cnt == 0:
        print(f"{name} valid pixels: {int(cnt) if cnt else 0}")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
        exit()
    if val is None or not -1 <= val <= 1:
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        exit()
    print(f"{name} Images: {col.size().getInfo()}, NDVI mean: {val:.4f}, Pixels: {int(cnt)}")
    return val

base_v = mean_nd(base, "2000-2015")
test_v = mean_nd(test, "2021-2022")

if test_v < base_v:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
